back_translation: The burden-oracle concerning Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz saw.
Raise a signal banner on a bare hilltop; lift up your voice to call them; wave the hand, that they may march in through the gates of the nobles.
I have commanded those I have consecrated; I have summoned my warriors for the punishment of my anger — those who exult in my greatness.
Listen! A tumult on the mountains, like that of a vast multitude! Listen! An uproar of kingdoms, of nations assembling! The LORD of Hosts is mustering an army for war.
They are coming from a distant land, from the end of the heavens — the LORD and the weapons of His wrath — to destroy the whole land.
Wail, for the Day of the LORD has drawn near; it will come like devastation from the Almighty.
Therefore all hands will hang limp, and every human heart will melt away.
They will be terrified; pain and torment will seize them; they will writhe like a woman giving birth. Each stares at the other in stunned shock, their faces flushed like flames.
Behold, the Day of the LORD is coming — a cruel day, with fury and burning anger — to make the land a desolation and to destroy the sinners out of it.
For the stars of heaven and all their Orion-constellations will not give their light; the sun will be dark from its rising, and the moon will not shed its light.
I will punish the world for its evil and the wicked for their iniquity. I will put an end to the arrogance of the proud and press down low the haughtiness of the ruthless.
I will make man scarcer than pure gold, and mankind rarer than the gold of Ophir.
Therefore I will make the heavens shudder, and the earth will be shaken out of its place, by the wrath of the LORD of Hosts, in the day of His burning anger.
And like a hunted gazelle, like a flock with no shepherd, each will turn back to his own people; each will flee to his own land.
Whoever is found will be pierced through, and whoever is caught will fall by the sword.
Their infants will be seized and dashed to pieces before their very eyes; their houses will be looted, and their wives will be violated.
Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them — men who care nothing for silver and have no desire for gold.
Their bows will dash the young men to pieces; they will show no mercy even to the fruit of the womb; their eyes will not pity the children.
And Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the glory and pride of the Chaldeans, will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
It will never be inhabited again; no one will settle there through all generations. No Arab will pitch his tent there, and no shepherd will let his flock lie down there.
But desert creatures will lie down there, and its houses will be full of howling creatures; ostriches will dwell there, and goat-demons will leap about there.
Hyenas will howl in its fortresses, and jackals in the luxurious palaces. Its time is near at hand, and its days will not be prolonged.
